specs_json.compute: NVIDIA Jetson Orin SoC + Qualcomm QRB5165/Snapdragon 865
specs_json.sensors: VT300-L / VT300-Z / V100-L pods; FLIR Boson+ 640x512 radiometric thermal, 64MP narrow, 50MP wide or 48MP tele

notes: US-made NDAA-compliant autonomy-first platform for DFR, inspection, defense. Onboard Jetson-class AI enables GPS-denied flight and night autonomy; dockable (Dock for X10).

failure_modes.name: VIO degradation in low-texture/low-light scenes
failure_modes.mitigation: enable night autonomy attachments/IR illumination, avoid featureless surfaces up close, keep nav lenses clean

failure_modes.name: Thermal throttling of Jetson Orin in hot climates
failure_modes.mitigation: limit ground idle time in sun, operate within -20 to 45°C envelope, keep vents unobstructed

failure_modes.name: Battery connector/latch wear on dock cycles
failure_modes.mitigation: inspect latch and contacts on schedule, replace batteries showing connector wear, firmware health checks

failure_modes.name: Prop damage from close-proximity inspection contact
failure_modes.mitigation: use standard OA margins where possible, pre/post-flight prop inspection, carry spares

failure_modes.name: Radio link loss in RF-shielded industrial interiors
failure_modes.mitigation: use 5G variant or plan lost-link behavior, stage repeaters, brief on lost-link contingencies
